content: Have you ever wondered how you can run, jump, see, and eat? You live inside a wonderful, moving machine. It's the most amazing machine in the world!
Think about this: If you want to grab a toy, what part of you does the grabbing? If you want to hear your favorite song, what part of you listens?

content.title: Your Super Robot Body
content.description: Imagine your body is like a friendly super robot! The head is at the top to look around, the arms are on the sides to reach things, and the legs are at the bottom to walk and jump!

content: This amazing machine is called your Human Body! It has many parts, and every part has a special name and a special job. Let's learn the names of these parts.

preview: The top part of your body. It has your eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.
The parts on the sides of your body that end in hands and fingers.
The parts at the bottom of your body that help you stand, walk, and run.

content: Point to your own body parts as you learn their names. This makes it super easy to remember!
Sometimes we forget that fingers are part of the hands, and toes are part of the feet. Remember, hands are on arms and feet are on legs!

question: Which part of your body helps you to run and jump?
Where are your eyes, ears, and nose located?

content: Look at yourself in a mirror. Can you name all the body parts you see? Try teaching your parents or a younger sibling where their nose, arms, and legs are!
Did you know that animals have body parts too? A dog has four legs, while you have two. A bird has wings instead of arms. Every living thing has a body made just for them!
Stand up and let's play 'Simon Says'! Simon says: Touch your head! Simon says: Wiggle your fingers! Simon says: Stomp your feet! Great job using your wonderful body!
